question: Should this PR wait for redacted real WhatsApp Desktop/group proof, or may a maintainer explicitly override the proof gate for the source-backed fix?
rationale: The patch looks like the right code path, but the remaining merge blocker is proof sufficiency for a visible WhatsApp Desktop behavior that tests cannot fully demonstrate.

options.title: Require Desktop Proof First
options.body: Ask for a redacted screenshot, recording, linked artifact, live output, or logs proving the after-fix reply bubble renders in a real WhatsApp group/Desktop flow.

options.title: Accept Maintainer Proof Override
options.body: A maintainer with paired WhatsApp access can validate the Desktop flow themselves and explicitly override the contributor proof gate.

options.title: Pause Until Proof Exists
options.body: Keep the PR open but unmerged, or close in favor of a maintainer-tested replacement, if no real WhatsApp proof can be produced.

recommendation.title: Require Desktop Proof First
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted screenshot, recording, linked artifact, live output, or logs proving the after-fix reply bubble renders in a real WhatsApp group/Desktop flow.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned to this PR and authored the current repair commits, so he is the clearest owner for proof sufficiency or override.
